**[Get WhisperShortcut on the Mac App Store](https://whispershortcut.com/go/appstore?src=github-release)** — automatic updates, one-time purchase.

## Meetings
- **Bluetooth earbuds record the other side correctly.** With AirPods or other Bluetooth earbuds in call mode, the Mac sound was captured at the wrong speed, so the transcript filled with made-up text. It is now recorded at the earbuds' real rate, and the capture restarts by itself when the output device changes format mid-meeting.
- **No more Glossary lines instead of real speech.** With GPT Transcribe, meetings no longer send your Glossary as hints, because on music or loud video the model answered with those terms ("Claude Code, MCP und Bachata.") instead of what was said. Dictation still uses the Glossary. Lines that are nothing but Glossary terms joined by "and" are now dropped too.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.68...v8.69
